name: catalog/cost_reconcile_stale
description: The invariants run (sweep, every 10 minutes) found no cost rows from the daily cost check (catalog-cost-reconcile) in the last 30 hours (M6-F1-R4).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND jsonPayload.message="invariant" AND jsonPayload.id="cost_reconcile_stale" AND jsonPayload.violations>0
